text:
Oli McBurnie’s injury-time brace helped Hull to a dramatic victory over Brighton but the Tigers had the heroics of their goalkeeper Konstantinos Tzolakis to thank for a result which continued their unbeaten home start since returning to the Premier League.
Fabian Hürzeler’s side were much the stronger of the teams on an afternoon they largely dominated. However, a string of chances in both halves passed them by without the goal their play deserved, thanks largely to Tzolakis, with the Greek international producing a string of sensational saves in both halves.
But after Brighton’s João Costinha was sent off for a second yellow card in the final moments, Hull pressed forward for an unlikely winner which they ultimately found, as McBurnie bundled home before tapping in a second two minutes later. It was a damaging afternoon for Brighton’s title hopes, who missed the chance to close the gap to Arsenal to three points.
How they did not secure at least a point is anyone’s guess. The Seagulls should not only have been in front at half-time, but ahead by such a margin that the game could have been over inside the opening 45 minutes.
Tzolakis was called into action early on, with a superb point-blank save to deny Diego Gómez from converting Maxim De Cuyper’s low cross. Gómez, De Cuyper and Yasin Ayari were causing mayhem on a frequent basis, with Ayari then next to miss a gilt-edged opportunity to open the scoring – but he could only fire a tame shot at Tzolakis.
Hull’s keeper was called into action again two minutes later; another slick Brighton move led to Ayari hitting the crossbar and from the rebound, Tzolakis reacted fastest to deny Georginio Rutter from inside the box before Gómez was next to miss a clearcut chance, with Tzolakis making another wonderful save with his foot to keep it goalless.
Half-time did little change the flow of momentum. Pascal Gross’ shot produced another reflex save from Tzolakis before Gómez then fired wide from six yards out, when it appeared easier to hit the target. You began to wonder if those missed opportunities were going to become costly, with Hull starting to become a threat at the other end, too.
On two separate occasions they countered Brighton attacks with wonderful breaks, but Mohamed Belloumi fluffed his lines both times after initially doing well to work the space for shots. Bart Verbruggen, mostly on a watching brief to that point, saved one before breathing a sigh of relief as the second squirmed wide of his post.
Hürzeler had seen enough. Three substitutes were introduced to try and find the breakthrough and one of those, Charalampos Kostoulas, finally beat Tzolakis with a clever chip over the Hull goalkeeper, but Regan Slater was on hand to hack the ball off the line and keep the game level heading into the final 10 minutes.
And all those Tzolakis saves ultimately proved crucial. When Costinha was shown a second yellow for a foul on the impressive Sorba Thomas, Hull surged forward with belief they could perhaps find a winner.
McBurnie then scrambled the ball past Verbruggen after Lucas Gourna-Douath was set free before, two minutes later, the Hull striker repeated the trick to double the Tigers’ lead and seal an incredible victory for the hosts.

חניכיו של פביאן הירצלר מברייטון שלטו לחלוטין במשחק ויצרו הזדמנויות הבקעה רבות לאורך שחקי המחציות, אך נתקלו ביום ענק של שוער הול סיטי, קונסטנטינוס צולאקיס, שמנע ספיגה שוב ושוב בהצלות מרהיבות. בין היתר, שחקני ברייטון כמו דיוגו גומז, יאסין איווארי ופסקל גרוס החמיצו מצבים קורצים מול השער.

בדקות הסיום של ההתמודדות, ז'ואאו קוסטין מברייטון הורחק בצהוב שני לאחר עבירה. הול סיטי ניצלה את החיסרון המספרי של היריבה ויצאה להתקפות מתפרצות שהובילו לשער היתרון של אולי מקברני בדקה ה-90, ולשער נוסף שנכבש שתי דקות לאחר מכן. התוצאה קטעה את רצף ההזדמנויות של ברייטון ופגעה בשאיפות הצמרת שלה, בעוד הול סיטי חגגה ניצחון ביתי גדול.
